_help: Team profiles shown ONLY when the live backend is unavailable (transcribed from the 'Our Experts' posters). Ids must be unique negative numbers. weeklySlots lists the session start times per weekday (full English day names, 24h HH:mm, written in the profile's own timeZone); each slot lasts durationMinutes. A profile may set its own durationMinutes, otherwise defaultDurationMinutes applies. timeZone is REQUIRED per profile and must be an IANA time zone name in Area/City form, case-sensitive: Asia/Jakarta (WIB, UTC+7), Asia/Makassar (WITA, UTC+8), Asia/Jayapura (WIT, UTC+9), Asia/Singapore, Australia/Sydney. Do NOT use abbreviations or offsets such as WIB, GMT+7 or UTC+7. Daylight saving is handled automatically. Leave out acceptsCouple to mean false. photo: file name only of an image placed in public/team/ (see src/data/README.md); leave "" to use the default portrait. gender: "FEMALE", "MALE" or "NEUTRAL" (picks the default portrait shown when there is no photo; never shown on the site). practiceMode: "ONLINE", "IN_PERSON" or "HYBRID"; IN_PERSON and HYBRID need at least one entry in locations ({ "label", "address" }, the first is the main one). languages: list of names, e.g. ["Bahasa Indonesia", "English"]. yearsExperience / licenceNumber: null when unknown. sessionFeeCents / sessionFeeCurrency mirror the backend fields (IDR 500,000 = 50000000); the fee is kept for the team and is NOT shown on the website.
